about_the_game:
Vape Shop Simulator is a first-person simulation game where you sell vapes and vaping related products to earn money and grow your store.

Manage The Shop: Order products, stock the shelves, and serve customers at the checkout. Run every part of the store and reinvest the profits into shop upgrades.
Brand Deals: Sign contracts with brands to gain access to new products to sell. The more variety you have, the more customers you will attract.

Expand Your Business: Grow your store in size and in profit. Increase the amount of floor space available to support more quantity and variety of stock.

Hire Employees: Share the workload. Increase your shops productivity by having employees perform tasks like operating the checkouts or stocking the shelves.

Protect Your Business: Defend your profits from thieves who will try to take from your shop and leave without paying.
